property_summary: For every caller address, calling sudicideAnyone() on the correct contract C only succeeds (does not revert and results in contract selfdestruct so address(c).balance becomes 0) when the caller is the owner; the mutant inverts the require and thus allows non-owners to succeed, violating this owner-only rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Invert the require condition so that only callers who are NOT the owner can call and trigger selfdestruct.
